review_scope: Independent lossless raw-JSON/numeric evidence audit; no arithmetic benchmarking or source edits

numeric_policy.integer_parser: JSON number tokenizer preserves out-of-safe-range integer tokens as exact decimal strings before JSON.parse; exact timestamps and integer equations compared with BigInt
numeric_policy.persisted_timestamps: Exact decimal strings for Unix ns, run boundaries, extended probes, and per-cell elapsed values; full raw sources remain immutable
numeric_policy.counts: operations=actual_total_jobs*N, exact BigInt products; 1e9 operation cap per region
numeric_policy.wins: Exact elapsed_A*jobs_B versus elapsed_B*jobs_A cross-products, not rounded display ratios
numeric_policy.floating_point: Recompute binary64 ns/sum, ns/RHS and same-round ratios; compare published numeric values with absolute tolerance 5e-13*max(1,abs(actual),abs(expected))
numeric_policy.statistics: Each cell has all eight unfiltered measured region means; min/median/max and arithmetic mean recomputed. Pooled elapsed/actual jobs separately labelled. Each comparison median is median of eight same-round ratios, never ratio of medians.

limitations: All statistics concern these finite same-core final-only field sums, shared canonical FE64 input corpus, frozen compiler/build and actual whole-job boundaries; no upper-layer, scalar, integration or world-record claim.

This audit does not run field arithmetic or regenerate the million-element RHS corpus in JavaScript. It verifies C++ exact-regeneration preservation receipts, seed/prefix/full hashes and identity with both retained P3 FE64 corpora; checksum identity is not a collision-proof proof of all input bytes.

Benchmarked complete jobs include seed reset, loads, conversion where applicable, reduction, whole-job call/barrier and final 32-byte materialization; input allocation and generation are excluded for every route. No resident FE52 array participates.
Only the last identical job output is checked per timed region; separate finite C++ raw-limb/Boost gates establish arithmetic qualification. This JSON audit does not rerun those gates.
CPU4 and powersave/turbo-enabled endpoints are verified, but endpoints do not establish continuous frequency, no migration, thermal control or absence of background/SMT activity.
S1 extensions retain their short prefixes in one continuous clock and normalize by actual total jobs. All calibration shorts remain present. No samples were removed, rerun or replaced.

Published summaries for these complete series contain all eight verified duration-qualified measurement samples; this pass does not exercise hypothetical failure paths or certify a future incomplete series.

Preregistered primary and all 13 secondary pair families are kept separate. Cross-series combined wins summarize pair counts only; separate series medians remain separate. No P3/P2/P1 or smoke timing is pooled.

Matched native-vs-FE52 controls change representation, packing and compiler choices together; bank controls include merge/live-state costs. Timing alone establishes no memory-bandwidth, cache, spill-cost, port-pressure or critical-path causality.
Dynamic PMU access was previously unavailable; no security setting changed and this numeric audit adds no PMU, CT certification or novelty evidence.
External manifest/binary/library/disassembly binding remains the manager's separate gate; matching source hashes are not themselves proof of the linked binary.
